metadata.title: Kinematic Structure of the Orion Nebula Cluster and its Surroundings

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's high-velocity discussion treats stars as possible cluster ejecta/runaways or as background objects, not as Galactic unbound candidates (T:p12-b3; T:p13-b0). JW 355 (0535109-052246) is mentioned only because Poveda et al. suggested it as a possible ONC runaway, while O'Dell et al. did not confirm the motion (T:p12-b3); a possible cluster runaway is not by itself a Galactic unbound candidate. The 21 high-RV stars are not assessed for Galactic unbound status (T:p13-b0), and the most deviant cases are instead classified as background stars/giants or an older background population (T:p13-b2; T:p13-b3; T:p13-b4). The high-RV star 0535503-044208 (F11 ap146) is noted as having cluster-related Hα emission, not as unbound (T:p13-b1). No explicit Galactic escape/unbound criterion is stated as satisfied.
